ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r6.claim: Kallā rebukes him and alerts him that his assumption and wish are mistaken; writing his boast stands for the punishment that follows, hence the future sīn in 'We shall write.'
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r6.anchor: وكلا ردع وتنبيه على الخطأ الذي هو مخطئ فيما تصوره لنفسه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r7.speaker: أبو نهيك
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r7.claim: Abū Nuhayk reads kallā with tanwīn twice, treating it as the verbal noun kalla, 'the sword failed to strike,' and supplies an implied verb: be weakened from worship or truth.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r7.anchor: وقرأ أبو نهيك كلا بالتنوين فيهما هنا وهو مصدر من كل السيف كلا

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r8.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī gives two senses of 'We shall write': his statement will become manifest and be shown to have been recorded, or the phrase is a conventional threat promising eventual revenge despite delay.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r9.claim: The future promise 'We shall extend for him' means prolonging his torment or increasing and multiplying its duration.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r9.anchor: ونمد أي نطول له من العذاب الذي يعذب به المستهزءون أو نزيده من العذاب

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r10.speaker: الجمهور والأعمش
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r10.claim: The majority read sanaktubu with nūn; al-Aʿmash reads it with passive voice, yāʾ and tāʾ.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p294/r10.anchor: وقرأ الجمهور سنكتب بالنون والأعمش بياء مضمومة والتاء مفتوحة مبنيا للمفعول

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p295/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p295/r1.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p295/r1.claim: ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib reads wa-namuddu lahu with an explicit plural verb.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v7p295/r1.anchor: وقرأ علي بن أبي طالب ونمد له

BURSEVI:v5p272#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v5p272#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v5p272#3/r4.claim: Kalla rejects the claim; God records his lies, disbelief, and mockery and will lengthen the punishment he deserves instead of increasing money and children.

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r1.claim: كلا rebukes and stops the blasphemous claim; this is the position of al-Khalil, Sibawayh, al-Akhfash, al-Mubarrad, and most Basrans.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r1.anchor: ردع وزجر عن التفوه بتلك العظيمة وفي ذلك تنبيه علي خطئه

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r2.claim: This is the Qur'an's first occurrence of كلا; it recurs thirty-three times, and Abu al-ʿAbbas forbids pausing at it.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r2.anchor: وهذا أول موضع وقع فيه من القرآن وقد تكرر في النصف الأخير فوقع في ثلاثة وثلاثين موضعا ولم يجوز أبو العباس الوقف عليه

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r3.speaker: الفراء
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r3.claim: Al-Farraʾ classifies occurrences into four pause and restart patterns; the first group permits both and includes this verse and nine other sites.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r3.anchor: وقال الفراء : هو على اربعة اقسام أحدها ما يحسن الوقوف عليه ويحسن الأبتداء به

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r4.speaker: الفراء
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r4.claim: His second group permits pausing but not restarting, illustrated by Moses fearing they would kill him and Israel saying they would be overtaken.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r4.anchor: فاخاف أن يقتلون قال كلا ) وقوله عز شأنه ( انا لمدركون قال كلا

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r5.speaker: الفراء
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r5.claim: His third group permits restarting but not pausing; his fourth permits neither, since ثم connects onward and the benefit lies in what follows.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r5.anchor: فانه لا يحسن الوقف على ثم لأنه حرف عطف ولا على كلا لأن الفائدة فيما بعد

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r6.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r6.claim: Another grammarian permits pausing at every كلا as “enough/stop,” except كلا والقمر, which remains connected to the oath.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r6.anchor: يحسن الوقف على كلا في جميع القرآن لأنه بمعنى انته إلا في موضع واحد

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r7.claim: سنكتب means God will expose the recorded statement publicly, or will take revenge as the record's consequence; the first is an expressive metaphor and the second names the cause.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r7.anchor: أي سنظهر انا كتبنا قوله كقوله

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r8.speaker: أبو السعود
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r8.claim: Abu al-Suʿud cites another interpretation in which writing stands metaphorically for the threat of revenge, while noting its obscurity.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r8.anchor: الكتابه في المعنى الثاني استعارة للوعيد بالانتقام وفيه خفاء

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r9.claim: The claim that the future particle merely intensifies a present act is rejected: it makes the promised future threat certain, not present.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r9.anchor: ورد بأن السين إذا اكدت فانما تؤكد الوعد أو الوعيد وتفيد أنه كائن لا محالة في المستقبل

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r10.speaker: الأعمش
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r10.claim: Al-Aʿmash reads the verb passively as سيكتب, “it will be written.”

ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r11.claim: The record is assured by the verse that every utterance has a watcher and by the statement that God's messengers write.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p130#3/r11.anchor: إلا لديه رقيب عتيد ) وقوله سبحانه

ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r1.claim: The extension of punishment replaces the extension the man claimed in wealth and children; it may mean lengthening punishment or multiplying it.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r1.anchor: مكان ما يدعيه لنفسه من الامداد بالمال والولد أي نطول له من العذاب ما يستحقه أو نزيد عذابه

ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r2.speaker: علي
ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r2.claim: A reading attributed to ʿAli has نمدّ with ḍamma, usable with or without the lām; adding the verbal noun intensifies the threat and divine anger.
ALUSI-FULL:v16p131/r2.anchor: بالضم وهو بهذا المعنى يجوز أن يستعمل باللام وبدونها

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r1.claim: The rebuttal denies the man's claim; God will preserve it and requite him, either by ordering angels to write his words or simply keeping them on record.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r1.anchor: {كلا} رد عليه يعني: لم يفعل ذلك {سنكتب} سنحفظ عليه {ما يقول}

BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r2.claim: Increasing punishment means either adding punishment beyond his existing punishment or prolonging its duration.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v5p254#2/r2.anchor: أي: نزيده عذابا فوق العذاب. وقيل: نطيل مدة عذابه.

BAYDAWI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.claim: “No” rebukes his mistaken self-image; God will expose his recorded words or exact retribution as for a recorded crime. Punishment will be prolonged or doubled for disbelief and mockery.
BAYDAWI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.anchor: ردع وتنبيه على أنه مخطىء فيما تصوره لنفسه

BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r4.claim: Kalla rejects both supposed grounds, the promised wealth and children, and tells him to abandon the claim in humiliation.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r4.anchor: لم يقع شيء من هذين الأمرين

BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r5.claim: God will preserve the claim for later reproach and punishment; alternatively, the future tense allows time for repentance before the record is made, an expression of general mercy.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r5.anchor: والإعلام بذلك للحث على التوبة قبل الكتابة

BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r6.claim: His punishment is extended through gradual causes: beloved wealth and children burden him with labor and disputes and deepen the unbelief that entails punishment after death.
BIQAI-FULL:v4p554/r6.anchor: باستدراجه بأسبابه من كثرة النعم من الأموال والأولاد المحببة له في الدنيا

QUSHAYRI:v2p247/r12.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v2p247/r12.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v2p247/r12.claim: The disbeliever's claim will not be realized; instead God will prolong his allotted punishment.
QUSHAYRI:v2p247/r12.anchor: ليس لقولهم تحقيق ، بل سنمد لهم من العذاب مدا أي سنطيل في العذاب مدتهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r1.claim: The choice of al-Raḥmān ironically evokes the mercy supposedly guaranteeing the unbeliever’s promised prosperity and needles Quraysh, who denied this divine name.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r1.anchor: واختير هنا من أسمائه { الرحمن } ، لأن استحضار مدلوله أجدر في وفائه بما عهد به

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r2.claim: Kallā is a repudiating rebuke that can answer one speaker or reject reported speech; it negates what came before, like a negative answer particle.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r2.anchor: و { كلا } حرف ردع وزجر عن مضمون كلام سابق من متكلم واحد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r3.claim: Although commonly placed after the false statement, kallā can precede it to reject it immediately and build anticipation; Arabs do not normally leave this rebuttal without following speech.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r3.anchor: ولما فيها من معنى الإبطال كانت في معنى النفي ، فهي نقيض إي وأجل ونحوهما من أحرف الجواب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r4.claim: Most scholars permit pausing after kallā because its rebuke is complete; al-Mubarrad disallows a pause, requiring following speech.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r4.anchor: فلذلك جاز الوقف عليها عند الجمهور ، ومنع المبرد الوقف عليها بناء على أنها لا بد أن تتبع بكلام

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r5.speaker: الفراء
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r5.claim: Al-Farrāʾ classifies four placements: pause and restart both work; pause alone works; restart alone works; or neither works, with Quranic examples for each.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r5.anchor: وقال الفراء : مواقعها أربعة : موقع يحسن الوقف عليها والابتداء بها كما في هذه الآية

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r6.claim: Al-Farrāʾ’s account makes the disagreement with al-Mubarrad largely verbal because pausing is broader than complete silence.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p161/r6.anchor: ولكونها حرف ردع أفادت معنى تاما يحسن السكوت عليه . فلذلك جاز الوقف عليها عند الجمهور ، ومنع المبرد الوقف عليها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r1.claim: Sawfa in “We shall write” assures that the threatened consequence will certainly occur, as in 12:98.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r1.anchor: وحرف التنفيس في قوله { سنكتب } لتحقيق أن ذلك واقع لا محالة كقوله تعالى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r2.claim: Madd in the punishment means increasing it, as it did in the respite of 19:75.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r2.anchor: والمد في العذاب : الزيادة منه ، كقوله : { فليمدد له الرحمن مدا }

IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r3.claim: “What he says” abbreviates his lengthy blasphemy and mockery, as well as his boast of future wealth and children; 3:183 uses the same concise reference to their words.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v16p162/r3.anchor: و { ما يقول } في الموضعين إيجاز ، لأنه لو حكي كلامه لطال

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r7.claim: Kallā rebukes the claim; God will preserve and punish the unbeliever for what he said.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r7.anchor: وكلا زجر ورد، ثم أخبر تعالى أن قول هذا الكافر سيكتب على معنى حفظه عليه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r8.speaker: أبو عمرو والحسن وعيسى
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r8.claim: Abū ʿAmr, al-Ḥasan, and ʿĪsā read sanaktubu with nūn.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r8.anchor: وقرأ «سنكتب» بالنون أبو عمرو والحسن وعيسى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r9.speaker: عاصم والأعمش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r9.claim: ʿĀṣim and al-Aʿmash read sayuktabu in the passive.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p30#2/r10.claim: Extending punishment means prolonging and intensifying it.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r1.claim: “No indeed” either rejects his prediction of wealth and children, or denies that he has knowledge of the unseen or a covenant with God.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r1.anchor: أي ليس الأمر على ما قال من أنه يؤتى المال والولد ويجوز أن يكون معنى كلا

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r2.claim: Recording his words means God orders the recording angels to write them down so he can be repaid for them.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r2.anchor: سنأمر الحفظة باثبات قوله عليه لنجازيه به

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r3.claim: Extending punishment means making one punishment follow another.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r3.anchor: أي نجعل بعض العذاب على إثر بعض

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r4.speaker: أبو العالية الرياحي وأبو رجاء العطاردي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r4.claim: These readers use passive forms with an open yāʾ for “will be written” and “will inherit.”
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v5p261#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ أبو العالية الرياحي وأبو رجاء العطاردي سيكتب ويرثه بياء مفتوحة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p259/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p259/r1.speaker: خباب بن الأرت
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p259/r1.claim: Khabbab says al-ʿAs ibn Wa'il refused to pay his debt unless he disavowed Muhammad; when Khabbab refused, al-ʿAs claimed he would have wealth and children after resurrection, prompting revelation. The canonical collections transmit it through several routes.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p259/r1.anchor: عن خباب بن الأرت قال: كنت رجلا قينا، وكان لي على العاص بن وائل دين، فأتيته أتقاضاه.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p261/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p261/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p261/r1.claim: Kalla rebukes the preceding claim and confirms what follows; God records the man's demand, self-assigned fate, and disbelief, then increases his afterlife punishment.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v5p261/r1.anchor: وقوله: {كلا} : هي حرف ردع لما قبلها وتأكيد لما بعدها، {سنكتب ما يقول}

JISHUMI:v6p4610/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4610/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p4610/r3.claim: The verse indicates that all deeds are written down and preserved.
JISHUMI:v6p4610/r3.anchor: وتدل على أن جميع الأعمال مكتوبة محفوظة

JISHUMI:v6p4610/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v6p4610/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v6p4610/r5.claim: God reproaches and threatens the man for making the boastful claim about what he will receive.
JISHUMI:v6p4610/r5.anchor: وتدل على أن ذلك القول فعله لذلك وبخه به وأوعده عليه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r1.claim: Although his words are already recorded, the future in سنكتب may mean God will reveal to him that they were recorded, as in a poem where lineage makes one's origins known.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r1.anchor: إذا ما انتسبنا لم تلدني لئيمة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r2.claim: Alternatively, it is a threat formula promising eventual vengeance even if punishment is delayed.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r2.anchor: يعني أنه لا يخل بالانتصار وإن تطاول

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r3.claim: God may lengthen the punishment appropriate to him or increase and multiply it; ʿAlī's reading ونمد with ḍamma supports the latter, reinforced by the verbal noun.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r3.anchor: أي نطول له من العذاب ما يستأهله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p41/r4.claim: The doubled punishment expresses the severity of God's anger.

MUQATIL:19:79-82/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r1.claim: “No indeed” denies that al-ʿĀṣ will receive what believers receive.
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r1.anchor: لا يعطي العاص ما يعطي المؤمنون

MUQATIL:19:79-82/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r2.claim: The recording is done by the guardian angels, who write down al-ʿĀṣ’s claim about receiving the believers’ reward.
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r2.anchor: من الحفظة من الملائكة تكتب ما يقول العاص أن يعطى ما يعطى المؤمنون في الجنة

MUQATIL:19:79-82/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:19:79-82/r3.claim: The punishment extended for al-ʿĀṣ has no end.

NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r1.claim: كلا rebukes and alerts the person to his error, commanding him to desist.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r1.anchor: ردع وتنبيه على الخطأ أي هو مخطئ فيما تصوره لنفسه فليرتدع عنه

NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r2.claim: Writing the statement means God will expose and make known that it was recorded, just as the cited verse says every utterance has a watcher.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r2.anchor: أي قوله والمراد سنظهر له ونعلمه أنا كتبنا قوله لأنه كما قال كتب من غير تأخير قال الله تعالى ما يلفظ من قول الا لديه رقيب عتيد

NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r3.claim: The cited poetic line illustrates that writing can mean coming to know and making something clear through attribution.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r3.anchor: وهو كقوله إذا ما انتسبنا لم تلدني لئيمة أي علم وتبين بالانتساب أني لست بابن لئيمة

NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r4.claim: God increases his punishment as he increases slander and audacity; the repeated infinitive intensifies the severity of divine anger.
NASAFI-FULL:v3p46#4/r4.anchor: نزيده من العذاب كما يزيد في الافتراء والاجتراء

QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r1.speaker: خباب
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r1.claim: Khabbāb had a debt owed by al-ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil; when pressed to deny Muḥammad, he refused until the debtor died and was raised, and al-ʿĀṣ mocked that he would repay when restored to wealth and children. The report is transmitted by Muslim and Bukhārī.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r1.anchor: عن خباب قال كان لي على العاص بن وائل دين فأتيته أتقاضاه

QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r2.speaker: الكلبي ومقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r2.claim: Al-Kalbī and Muqātil say blacksmith Khabbāb had made jewelry for al-ʿĀṣ; al-ʿĀṣ mocked repayment in Paradise, claiming he would have wealth there and Khabbāb no greater entitlement.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-80/r2.anchor: وقال الكلبي ومقاتل: كان خباب قينا فصاغ للعاص حليا

QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r8.claim: “Kallā” has two senses, “indeed” or “no”; if “no,” one may pause on it, while “indeed” permits pausing before and restarting with it.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r8.anchor: وهو يكون بمعنيين: أحدهما: بمعنى حقا. والثاني: بمعنى لا

QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r9.claim: “Kallā” does not occur in the first half of the Qurʾān but appears in the second; the correct pause depends on its meaning.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r9.anchor: ليس في النصف الأول ذكر «كلا» وإنما جاء ذكره في النصف الثاني

QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r10.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r10.claim: One may pause at “ʿahdan” and begin “kallā” as “indeed, We will record what he says.”
QURTUBI-FULL:19:77-79/r10.anchor: ويجوز أن تقف على قوله: «عهدا» وتبتدىء «كلا» أي حقا

QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.speaker: الفراء
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.claim: Al-Farrāʾ treats “kallā” as a connective like “sawfa,” or as a self-sufficient rebuttal like yes or no; when it links to what follows in an oath, one should not pause on it.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r1.anchor: وقال الفراء: «كلا» بمنزلة سوف لأنها صلة، وهي حرف رد

QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r2.speaker: أبو جعفر محمد بن سعدان
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r2.claim: Abū Jaʿfar ibn Saʿdān takes the same position on “kallā” as al-Farrāʾ.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r2.anchor: وكان أبو جعفر محمد بن سعدان يقول في «كلا» مثل قول الفراء

QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r3.speaker: الأخفش
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r3.claim: Al-Akhfash defines “kallā” as rebuke and restraint.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r3.anchor: وقال الأخفش: معنى كلا الردع والزجر

QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r4.speaker: أبو بكر بن الأنباري
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r4.claim: Ibn al-Anbārī reports Abū al-ʿAbbās’s view that one should never stop at “kallā,” since its point comes afterward.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r4.anchor: لا يوقف على «كلا» في جميع القرآن لأنها جواب

QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r5.claim: Al-Qurṭubī says the first interpretation is the exegetes’ position.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r5.anchor: والقول الأول هو قول أهل التفسير

QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r6.claim: God preserves the man’s statement to recompense him and extends his punishment with additional torment.
QURTUBI-FULL:19:79-80/r6.anchor: أي سنحفظ عليه قوله فنجازيه به في الآخرة

RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r10.claim: Kallā rebukes and alerts the claimant that he is mistaken in what he says and hopes for.
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r10.anchor: فقال : { كلا } وهي كلمة ردع وتنبيه على الخطأ

RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r11.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r11.claim: Although the record is already made, the future tense can mean the claimant will later see and learn that God recorded his words.

RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r12.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r12.claim: Alternatively, future threat language is used for emphasis even when punishment is already underway; the same threatening idiom applies here.
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r12.anchor: المتوعد يقول للجاني سوف أنتقم منك وإن كان في الحال في الانتقام

RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r13.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r13.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r13.claim: God will prolong and increase the punishment the man deserves; madda and amadda can both mean to extend it.
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r13.anchor: أي نطول له من العذاب ما يستأهله ونزيده من العذاب

RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r14.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r14.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r14.claim: Ali is reported to read the verb with ḍamma on its initial yāʾ, يمد له.
RAZI-FULL:v21p213/r14.anchor: ويدل عليه قراءة علي بن أبي طالب عليه السلام ويمد له بالضم

STUDYQURAN:19:79/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:19:79/r1.speaker: Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:19:79/r1.claim: Nay answers the question in verse 78: the disbeliever knows neither the Unseen nor a pact with God.
STUDYQURAN:19:79/r1.anchor: does not have knowledge of the Unseen or a pact with God (Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:19:79/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:19:79/r2.speaker: Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:19:79/r2.claim: God prolongs his punishment because he compounds disbelief with lies and vain claims.
STUDYQURAN:19:79/r2.anchor: because he has compounded his disbelief with lies and vain claims (Ṭ)

TABATABAI:19:78-79/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:78-79/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:78-79/r7.claim: Kallā is a rebuke: disbelief does not cause wealth and children; the actual consequence of his claim and disbelief is extended punishment.
TABATABAI:19:78-79/r7.anchor: كلا كلمة ردع وزجر وذيل الآية دليل على أنه سبحانه يرد بها ما يتضمنه قول هذا القائل من ترتب إيتاء المال والولد على الكفر بآيات الله

TABATABAI:19:80/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:80/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:80/r3.claim: The nearest reading of writing his words is establishing them so their consequence follows, rather than recording them in a ledger; the next verse would otherwise repeat the point without an evident purpose.
TABATABAI:19:80/r3.anchor: تثبيته ليترتب عليه أثره لا كتابته في صحيفة عمله

TABATABAI:19:80/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:80/r4.speaker: الأكثر
TABATABAI:19:80/r4.claim: On the majority reading, the speaker is ʿĀṣ ibn Wāʾil or al-Walīd ibn al-Mughīra, who swears he will receive wealth and children in Paradise after resurrection; God asks whether he knows the unseen or has a covenant, then strips him of possessions and brings him alone.
TABATABAI:19:80/r4.anchor: بناء على كونه ناظرا إلى الإيتاء في الآخرة كما اختاره الأكثر فمعنى الآيات كما فسروها تعجب من الذي كفر بآياتنا وهو عاص بن وائل أو وليد بن المغيرة

TABATABAI:19:80#2/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:19:80#2/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:19:80#2/r2.claim: The reports do not fit the context: they make the saying a mockery by someone who denied resurrection, whereas the passage answers it with a serious argument.
TABATABAI:19:80#2/r2.anchor: على صراحتها في كونها كلمة استهزاء لا تنطبق على الآية

TABRISI:19:78-82/r10.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:78-82/r10.speaker: author
TABRISI:19:78-82/r10.claim: Kallā rejects his claim that he will receive wealth and children, or denies that he knows the unseen or holds a covenant with God.
TABRISI:19:78-82/r10.anchor: أي ليس الأمر على ما قال من أنه يؤتى المال والولد

TABRISI:19:78-82/r11.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:78-82/r11.speaker: author
TABRISI:19:78-82/r11.claim: God will instruct the recording angels to register what he says so that he is requited for it in the Hereafter.
TABRISI:19:78-82/r11.anchor: سنأمر الحفظة بإثباته عليه لنجازيه به في الآخرة

TABRISI:19:78-82/r12.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:19:78-82/r12.speaker: author
TABRISI:19:78-82/r12.claim: God will add punishment to punishment, linking its parts so that it never ends; the verbal noun intensifies the verb like repetition does.
TABRISI:19:78-82/r12.anchor: نصل له بعض العذاب بالبعض ونزيده عذابا فوق العذاب فلا ينقطع عذابه أبدا

THALABI:v6p229/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v6p229/r8.speaker: author
THALABI:v6p229/r8.claim: Kallā rejects the boast; God will record and preserve what the man says about wealth and children.
THALABI:v6p229/r8.anchor: كلا رد عليه يعني لم يفعل ذلك سنكتب سنحفظ عليه ما يقول يعني المال والولد

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r1.claim: On the preceding analysis, kalla may mean ألا, but not on Abu Hatim’s analysis, where it introduces a new opening rather than meaning emphatically true.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r1.anchor: وعلى هذا يجوز أن تكون بمعنى (ألا)، ولا يجوز على الوجه الذي ذكره أبو حاتم؛ لأنه يجعله افتتاحا لا بمعنى حقا.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r2.speaker: أبو العباس أحمد بن يحيى
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r2.claim: Do not pause at kalla anywhere in the Qur’an, since it is a response whose meaning is completed by what follows.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r2.anchor: فقال أبو العباس أحمد بن يحيى: (لا يوقف على {كلا} في جميع القرآن؛ لأنها جواب والفائدة تقع فيما بعدها)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r3.claim: Other scholars permit pausing at kalla everywhere, while another group pauses before it and starts with it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r3.anchor: ومنهم من قال: (يوقف على {كلا} في جميع القرآن)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r4.speaker: ابن الأنباري
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r4.claim: In this verse it is permissible to pause at kalla because it means the claim is false; one may also pause at covenant and then negate both seeing the unseen and making a covenant.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r4.anchor: فأما في هذه الآية فقال ابن الأنباري: (الوقف على {كلا} جائز؛ لأن المعنى ليس الأمر)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r5.claim: Another explanation is that the claim of receiving wealth and children is not as he supposes.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r5.anchor: ومنهم من قال: (معناه: ليس الأمر كما يظنه من أنه يؤتى المال والولد)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r6.claim: God will have the recording angels write his statement to repay him, and will extend his punishment beyond the punishment already due.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v14p316/r6.anchor: وقوله تعالى: {كلا سنكتب ما يقول} أي: سنأمر الحفظة بإثباته لنجازيه في الآخرة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:79-81/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:79-81/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:79-81/r1.claim: No: matters are not as he says; God records his unbelief and mockery to repay him and will add punishment upon punishment.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:19:79-81/r1.anchor: كلا } ليس الأمر كما يقول: { سنكتب ما يقول } سيحفظ عليه ما يقول من الكفر والاستهزاء لنجازيه به { ونمد له من العذاب مدا } نزيده عذابا فوق العذاب.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p241/r6.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p241/r6.speaker: خباب بن الأرت
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p241/r6.claim: Khabbāb reports that al-ʿĀṣ b. Wāʾil withheld his wages unless he disavowed Muhammad, then promised to repay after resurrection from future wealth and children; Khabbāb told the Prophet, and these verses were revealed.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p241/r6.anchor: عن خباب بن الأرت قال: كنت قينا في الجاهلية فعملت للعاصي بن وائل حتى اجتمعت لي عنده دراهم

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r5.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r5.speaker: السدي
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r5.claim: Al-Suddī explains that the punishment will have no end.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r5.anchor: يعني لا انقطاع له. تفسير السدي

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r6.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r6.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r6.claim: The endless punishment recalls 78:30, which says that only more punishment will be added.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p242/r6.anchor: قال يحيى: وهو كقوله: {فذوقوا فلن نزيدكم إلا عذابا} [النبأ: 30]

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r1.speaker: جمهور البصريين
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r1.claim: The Basran majority, including al-Khalil, Sibawayh, al-Akhfash, and Abu al-ʿAbbas, take كلا as a rebuke fitting its Quranic contexts and this claimant.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r1.anchor: أحدها:- وهو مذهب جمهور البصريين كالخليل وسيبويه وأبي الحسن الأخفش وأبي العباس - أنها حرف ردع وزجر،

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r2.speaker: النضر بن شميل
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r2.claim: Al-Nadr says كلا can affirmatively mean نعم, as an answer requiring a preceding statement, and can also occur in oaths.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r2.anchor: والثاني: - وهو مذهب النضر بن شميل أنها حرف تصديق بمعنى نعم، فتكون جوابا،

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r3.speaker: الكسائي
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r3.claim: Al-Kisa'i and others interpret كلا as حقا, truly.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r3.anchor: والثالث: - وهو مذهب الكسائي وأبي بكر بن الأنباري ونصير بن يوسف وابن واصل -

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r4.speaker: محمد بن الباهلي
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r4.claim: Al-Bahili takes كلا as rejecting what came before, close to rebuke.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r4.anchor: محمد بن الباهلي- أنها رد لما قبلها وهذا قريب من معنى الردع.

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r5.claim: The proposed filler meaning إي is questionable because إي is an answer particle restricted to oaths.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r5.anchor: وفيه نظر فإن " إي " حرف جواب ولكنه مختص بالقسم.

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r6.speaker: أبو حاتم
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r6.claim: Abu Hatim analyzes كلا as an opening particle.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r6.anchor: السادس: أنها حرف استفتاح وهو قول أبي حاتم.

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r7.speaker: أبو نهيك
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r7.claim: Abu Nuhayk is reported to read كلا with fatḥa and tanwin; a later attribution calls him Ibn Nuhayk, but the source corrects it to Abu Nuhayk.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r7.anchor: وقد قرئ هنا بالفتح والتنوين في " كلا " هذه، وتروى عن أبي نهيك.

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r8.claim: The fatḥa/tanwin reading can be an accusative verbal noun from an implied verb of failing or tiring, using the idiom كل السيف for a sword growing dull.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r8.anchor: أنه منصوب على المصدر بفعل مقدر من لفظها تقديره: كلوا كلا،

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r9.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r9.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r9.claim: Another parse makes it an object of implied حملوا, since الكل means a burden; the Quran describes a person as a burden.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r9.anchor: أنه مفعول به بفعل مقدر من معنى الكلام تقديره: حملوا كلا،

SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r10.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r10.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r10.claim: A third parse treats the tanwin as replacing the alif of the rebuke particle.
SAMIN-DURR:19:82/r10.anchor: أن التنوين بدل من ألف " كلا " وهي التي يراد بها الردع والزجر،

SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r1.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r1.claim: Zamakhshari says the rebuke particle's final alif was changed to nūn at pause, like قواريرا, if the report is sound.
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r1.anchor: قال الزمخشري: " ولقائل أن يقول: إن صحت هذه الرواية فهي " كلا " التي للردع،

SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r2.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r2.claim: He rejects the analogy: an indeclinable particle has no reason to exchange alif for nūn, while قواريرا has ordinary tanwin under accepted analyses or dialect.
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r2.anchor: قال الشيخ: " وهذا ليس بجيد لأنه قال: " التي للردع " والتي للردع حرف ولا وجه لقلب ألفها نونا،

SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r3.speaker: ابن عطية
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAtiyya calls the tanwin form an adjective of the idols; the author finds the meaning unsuitable but allows a reading as exhausted or incapable.
SAMIN-DURR:19:79/r3.anchor: والرابع: أنه نعت ل " آلهة " قاله ابن عطية. وفيه نظر، إذ ليس المعنى على ذلك.

ZAJJAJ:v3p344/r8.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v3p344/r8.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v3p344/r8.claim: كلا is a rebuke and warning that makes the speaker recognize the error in his claim.
ZAJJAJ:v3p344/r8.anchor: ردع وتنبيه، أي هذا مما يرتدع منه

ZAJJAJ:v3p344/r9.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v3p344/r9.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v3p344/r9.claim: سنكتب ما يقول means God will preserve his words against him.

BURHAN:v4p81/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p81/r4.speaker: الراغب
BURHAN:v4p81/r4.claim: Al-Raghib observes that أمداد is most often used for blessings, while مدّ is used for punishment, as in “We extend punishment for him.”
BURHAN:v4p81/r4.anchor: قال الراغب اكثر ( 6 ) ما جاء الامداد في المحبوب

ITQAN:v2p570/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p570/r4.speaker: الراغب
ITQAN:v2p570/r4.claim: Al-Raghib distinguishes amdad from madd: supplying is usually used for what is welcome, while prolonging is used for what is painful.
ITQAN:v2p570/r4.anchor: أكثر ما جاء الإمداد في المحبوب نحو ﴿ وأمددناهم بفاكهة ﴾ والمد في المكروه

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r1.speaker: الأخفش
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r1.claim: Al-Akhfash and Ibn Qutayba say kallā means reproof and restraint.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r1.anchor: قال الأخفش وابن قتيبة ) : معنى كلا الردع والزجر

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r2.speaker: السجستاني
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r2.claim: Al-Sijistānī takes kallā to mean lā, denying the preceding claim; al-ʿAjjāj’s verse illustrates this usage.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r2.anchor: وقال السجستاني تكون بمعنى ' لا ' أي : لا يكون ذلك وهو رد للأول

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r3.speaker: المفسرون
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r3.claim: One of two Qur’anic senses is no, rejecting what was just asserted; the source groups fourteen occurrences under this sense.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p511/r3.anchor: وذكر المفسرون أنها في القرآن على وجهين

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r1.claim: Madd originally means extending something to the furthest length, with contextual metaphorical extensions.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r1.anchor: الأصل في المد : بسط الشيء إلى نهاية طوله

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r3.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r3.claim: A second sense is duration or continuance, as in extending punishment and the everlasting shade of Paradise.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p555/r3.anchor: والثاني : الدوام . ومنه قوله تعالى في مريم :

BUKHARI:4735/r1.author: BUKHARI
BUKHARI:4735/r1.speaker: خباب
BUKHARI:4735/r1.claim: Khabbab reports that al-As ibn Wa'il promised to pay his debt from wealth and children after resurrection; the passage was revealed to reject that boast and foretell punishment and his solitary return to God.
BUKHARI:4735/r1.anchor: عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ خَبَّابٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ رَجُلًا قَيِّنًا، وَكَانَ لِي عَلَى الْعَاصِي بْنِ وَائِلٍ دَيْنٌ
